To: d.kerrigan@northmail.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: none
Subject: Re: Blister packs for my mother - new patient

Dear Mr Kerrigan,

Thank you for getting in touch. I’m sorry to hear about your mother’s fall. We would be pleased to help Margaret settle in at home and make her medications easier to manage.

We prepare weekly blister packs, with compartments for up to four times a day. There is no charge for the packaging itself. Margaret would pay the usual dispensing charges, and Ontario Drug Benefit coverage should cover most of her eligible medication costs.

We can deliver to her building on Mississauga Valley Boulevard. Our regular delivery days are Tuesday and Friday, between 2 and 6 p.m., and delivery is free within 8 km. For her first packs, we can either hold them for pickup on Saturday or arrange a one-time delivery before 1 p.m. that day.

To transfer her existing prescriptions, we can contact her current pharmacy for you. Please send us its name and address, along with Margaret’s OHIP number. She does not need to sign a transfer form.

Please also ask the hospital to fax her discharge prescriptions to us early Thursday. We need approximately 48 hours after receiving all of her prescriptions, including both the discharge prescriptions and the transfers, to prepare the first packs. If we receive everything in time, we expect to have them ready Saturday.

Unfortunately, the first packs will not be ready when Margaret is discharged on Thursday. Please confirm with the discharge team that she has an interim supply of every medication she needs and that there is a plan to help her with every dose until the packs are picked up or delivered on Saturday. If there is any uncertainty about that plan, please let us know.

I would be happy to go over Margaret’s new medication list with you. Before we discuss her medications with you, we need her permission. Our pharmacy records this using a signed Family Communication Consent form; it is there to protect her privacy while allowing us to support you in helping her. She can sign it at pickup, or we can send it with the driver.

I would also be happy to offer Margaret a MedsCheck at home during her first week back. It takes about 20 minutes, and I could visit Monday or Tuesday after 6 p.m. Please let me know if either evening would suit her.

You can reach me directly at 905-555-0148 ext. 2. I’m in the store Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Once Margaret has given her permission, we can also arrange a suitable time to speak in the evening.

Please let me know the pharmacy details, whether you would prefer Saturday pickup or delivery, and which evening might work for the home visit. We look forward to helping Margaret make a comfortable transition home.

Kind regards,

Rania Haddad
Pharmacist
Erindale Park Pharmacy
